description.value: Pamola Bakery & Deli is a Mexican deli located on Quayside Drive in New Westminster's waterfront neighbourhood, serving a broad menu of tacos, burritos, enchiladas, tamales, and quesadillas. Despite its bakery name, the offering is entirely Mexican deli cuisine with both indoor and outdoor seating. It is wheelchair accessible and accepts credit and debit cards.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 46m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 48m; stands (10 spaces) at 48m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active (copyright 2012–2025) and identifies itself as 'Pamola Bakery & Deli', operating as a Mexican deli restaurant with a menu of tacos, burritos, enchiladas, and tamales — not a traditional bakery or grocery store as OSM's shop=bakery/cuisine=bread tags suggest. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned in either the OSM tags or website content; the hot food amenity is clearly supported by the full deli menu on /menu-new.htm.
concerns: Website name is 'Pamola Bakery & Deli' — differs from OSM name 'Pamola Bakery'; used website value per rule 12.
OSM tags shop=bakery and cuisine=bread, but the website menu is entirely Mexican food — OSM category and cuisine tags are inaccurate.
OSM address lacks a street number; unit 117 is present in addr:unit, giving a best-guess address of 117 Quayside Drive.
The /menu.htm subpage returns a 404 error, indicating partial website breakage.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating deli/restaurant in a waterfront community; a useful food stop for touring cyclists.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags shop=bakery and cuisine=bread, but the website menu is entirely Mexican deli cuisine (tacos, burritos, enchiladas, tamales, tortas). This business functions as a deli/restaurant, not a bakery or grocery store.
